flow.description: First flow after the horizon, at the end of period N + 1, in currency units.

growth.description:
Growth of the flow per period, decimal fraction, greater than -1. Default: 0 (constant
flow).

growth_cap.description:
Upper bound for the growth, decimal fraction per period. Default: none, reported as
absent. A growth above the cap is reported, not refused.

periods.description: Number of further periods n during which the flow lasts, from 1 to 10000.

rate.description: Discount rate of the terminal phase, decimal fraction per period, greater than -1.

residual_value.description: Residual value at the end of period N + n, in currency units. Default: 0.
